# SLWBR58 Cafe (Slowbar Coffee)
> Independent third-wave slowbar coffee shop at 2080 Camden Ave. cor. Saint Jude, Area 12, Brookside Hills Subd., Cainta, Rizal. Tue–Thu 1 PM–8 PM · Fri–Sun 1 PM–9 PM · Closed Mon. Order via Facebook Messenger.

- [Home](https://slwbr58cafe.github.io/slwbr58.cafe/): SLWBR58 Cafe is a third-wave slowbar coffee shop in Brookside Hills, Cainta, Rizal. Iced lattes, matcha and more from ₱50. Order via Messenger. Open Tue–Sun.
